lines.text: Welcome to the Hearth & Anvil, delver. Warm seat, cool head, steady hands.
Mind the Three‑Wide Law: cut three across so the rock exhales, not bites.
If the Deepsong hums low, veins are near; if it keens, brace and mark your way.
Bind copper to haft and tooth; your first pick will learn your swing.
When stone thwarts you, seek a reinforced pick; temper comes after patience.
Orecasters once drank here, reading sparks in foam, mapping seams by toast.
Goblins skulk and burrowers mutter. If dust stills, listen and choose your path.
Bring oddments to the counter; sell, mend, upgrade. Ledgers remember for you.
Brewmaster takes notions. Leave a note; the casks ferry good ideas to me.
Lamps drink slow tonight; hear the rafters tick like clockwork roots.
